PDF.js OpenJPEG decoder assets

Source: mozilla/pdf.js commit accfa9a162c66988d2a3a3744e9806e674886655

The generated `openjpeg.mjs` adapter and `openjpeg.wasm` binary are copied
from `external/openjpeg/` in that source tree. See `LICENSE_OPENJPEG` and
`LICENSE_PDFJS_OPENJPEG` for the redistributed OpenJPEG decoder and PDF.js
adapter licenses.
